summary: Two UTV occupants seriously injured when the driver lost control and the UTV rolled approximately 200 feet down a steep embankment about 7.5 miles up a rough 4x4 trail off Stillwater Pass; an iPhone crash-detection alert notified 911 and 13 Grand County SAR members responded with Grand County EMS and the Grand County Sheriff's Office; the male subject was carried down by GCSAR in an off-road rescue trailer and airlifted by Medevac with life-threatening injuries, the female subject transported by UTV to a GCEMS ambulance; both hospitalized.
location: ~7.5 miles up a rough 4x4 trail off Stillwater Pass
notes: Source: Grand County Search and Rescue Facebook page post (2026-09-23). Second serious UTV crash GCSAR responded to in the past week.
